Name: Adarin's Girl Mod with Alternate Art (Obsolete)
Author: Deltadiamond
Description:
[size=5][b]This mod is obsolete.[/b]

[/size]LadyOfTheLight has uploaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764]a substantially better version[/url], complete with seasonal outfits. Hell, the only reason I'm leaving this up is so that it won't cause problems for anyone who has this version installed already.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764]Seasonal Female Bachelor Portraits and Sprites[/url]




Former Description:


Disclaimer: This is an attempt to make old mods workable with SMAPI. None of this is my own work.

Let's say you've come across that mod that changes all the bachelors into bachelorettes, and then you come across komina12345's collection of mods that change the outfits of said bachelorettes. And what if you want to run exrenkon's female Shane mod? Unfortunately for you, the latter are all .xnb files, which SMAPI won't load. So here I am as your savior to deliver a CP to fix that problem!

This mod is a CP that replaces all of the portraits and sprites for all 6 of the game's bachelors. The portraits and sprites all come from 3 different artists:

[b]Harriet (Harvey)[/b] and [b]Sam[/b] from AdarinSinner
[b]Alex[/b], [b]Elena (Elliot[/b]), and [b]Sabrina (Sebastian)[/b] from komina12345
[b]Shane[/b] from exrenkon

There's no need to run any of the other "girl" mods to get this to work, and it's honestly simpler if you don't. I highly recommend you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes.

[/url]Awkwardness can ensue when modded characters enter the picture, which isn't really something that one can fix.

I'm not an artist, and this isn't my work in the first place. In other words, unless I hear that there's another edit this mod won't change.
